title: Artifact
description: A content- or revision-addressable object participating in provenance. Artifacts are the entities derivations move between: a source archive and a lockfile are inputs, a build artifact is an intermediate, and a WASM is an output that may itself become a deployment artifact. Every artifact carries identity, type, digest where required, its parent derivation and the evidence supporting it.

id.description: The artifact's identifier within the producing document. Stable and unique within the document, so that two references to the same artifact resolve to the same object.

type.description: The artifact class. Constrained to artifact-types; an unknown term requires the consumer to treat the artifact as UNKNOWN rather than to guess a class.

digest.description: The content digest. Required for every artifact type in this version, because an artifact whose content is not addressed by a digest cannot participate in an identity comparison and would therefore make every claim about it unfalsifiable.

sizeBytes.description: The artifact size in bytes, where known.

mediaType.description: The IANA media type of the artifact, where known. Informational; never used for matching.

locator.description: Where the artifact was retrieved from, when retrieval is how it was established. Recorded so the evidence can be independently revisited, while never being treated as identity.

parent.description: The artifact this artifact was directly derived from, when the derivation is one-to-one. For derivations with several inputs, use inputs.

derivation.description: How the parent produced this artifact.

inputs.description: Every input that contributed to this artifact. Recorded as a set rather than a chain because a real build has several inputs (source, lockfile, configuration) and collapsing them to one parent loses the information verification needs.

type.description: The input artifact's class. References this schema's own enumeration so the two cannot drift.

derived.description: Artifacts directly produced from this artifact.

reproducible.description: Whether this artifact's digest reproduces from the same inputs and configuration.

evidence.description: Evidence references supporting this artifact's existence and identity.
